finding.headline: "Feeding Two: Toddler Meals Collapsed While I Nurse"
finding.problem: "I can't make eba or rice while holding a baby who won't unlatch. My toddler eats toast and doesn't recognise a proper meal. I feel like a bad Igbo wife."
finding.person: Mum who can't cook a proper meal for her toddler because she's pinned under a breastfeeding newborn 8×/day; toddler lives on biscuits.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (one-handed family-meal system) — strong diaspora + local". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
